verdict.rationale: pnpm's docs establish it as a full npm-compatible CLI (pnpm-docs-1/17) that manages both package.json and pnpm-lock.yaml automatically, with dry-run mode showing exactly what an install/add would change before writing to disk (pnpm-docs-9/19), frozen-lockfile enforcement in CI (pnpm-docs-13), and catalog/version pinning mechanisms in pnpm-workspace.yaml for controlled upgrades (pnpm-docs-7). The official CLI reference is linked (pnpm-probe-4), and audit/patch commands (pnpm-docs-3/11) show manifest/lockfile-safe workflows are core to the tool. missing for 10: explicit citation of `pnpm add`/`pnpm remove`/`pnpm update` command docs and their exact manifest/lockfile-write behavior, and independent hands-on confirmation that an agent using these commands never needs manual lockfile edits.
